text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Sev2 — elevated 5xx rates from edge -> gateway (auto-detect). Paging on-call: @sasha_oncall. See: https://runbook.internal/incidents/tls-checks :rotating_light:

infra-bot: alert metrics: 5xx rate +420% in last 5m, mean latency up 3x, spike originates from eu-west edge cluster. Samples show TLS handshake aborts.

sasha_oncall: I'm on it. quick check: dashboards + traces. tagging karim. karim_sre: i'm awake, joining.

alice_product: flagged by customers — two enterprise tenants reporting API errors and token retries. ETA on impact estimate?

karim_sre: looking at edge logs. here's a tail of error lines from proxy instances (abbreviated):
```
2026-02-15T09:12:03Z edge-12 ssl: handshake failed: certificate verification failed: x509: certificate has expired
2026-02-15T09:12:04Z edge-07 ssl: client hello rejected: verify failed: unknown_ca
2026-02-15T09:12:05Z edge-09 connection: upstream 502 gateway error (handshake aborted)
```

ben_dev: can we confirm which cert? leaf, intermediate, or root? rotator status?

karim_sre: rotator status shows recent rotation job for intermed-2025-09 completed, but OCSP responses are failing for that chain. suspect intermediate expired or OCSP responder misconfig. running `openssl s_client -connect gateway.internal:443 -servername api.redwood.dev -status` now.

karim_sre: openssl output snippet:
```
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=1 C = US, O = ExampleCA, CN = Redwood Intermediate CA
verify error:num=10:certificate has expired
notAfter=2026-02-15T08:59:59Z
---
OCSP response: no response sent
```

emily_support: customers: 2 orgs on eu region saw >50% request failures for 9m, some retry loops causing rate-limited UX. raising a wave to account mgmt.

sasha_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) failover traffic away from impacted edge cluster to eu-west-2 backup; 2) enable TLS fallback policy to allow older CA chain for 30m while we load a new intermediate; 3) rotate certs on gateway if needed. doing 1) now.

karim_sre: executing route shift: `infractl traffic steer --from=edge-eu-west-1 --to=edge-eu-west-2 --percentage=100 --dry-run=false`

infra-bot: traffic steer in progress. control-plane tasks: 6/8 completed, proxy reloads queued.

sasha_oncall: starting quick fix: deploy temporary intermediate bundle (signed by root) to gateway rotator with TTL 1h. karim, want you to validate rotator push. ben, please prepare rollback steps.

ben_dev: prepping rollback: commands and checks in #eng-runtime-runbook. quick note: if we bypass OCSP checks, we must record audit and revert within 1h.

karim_sre: pushed intermediate bundle to canary gateway, verifying. curl test to /v1/health returns 200, TLS chain now valid on canary: `openssl verify -CAfile root.pem chain.pem: OK`

sasha_oncall: good. scaling traffic back to canary 20% then 100% after 5m observation. monitoring error rates.

incident-bot: update: severity remains Sev2 while mitigation underway. annotation: "temporary intermediate applied; traffic steered; OCSP responder investigation ongoing"

alice_product: customer impact: two enterprise tenants degraded — we estimate 4k requests failed in the window, some with retries. notifying affected customers via support playbook.

emily_support: notifying customers now w/ status page link and workaround (retry/backoff). support ticket #INC-20981 created, CSMs looped.

karim_sre: OCSP responder logs show misconfig — responder container crashed due to JVM OOM at 08:58 UTC, restart happened but stale responses persisted. correlates with notAfter time for intermediate. engineering on OCSP team alerted.

ben_dev: OCSP team says they will restart responder and warm cache; prepping a permanent intermediate reissue with later expiry.

sasha_oncall: timeline/notes for handoff and action items: 
- Action: OCSP team to confirm responder healthy and backfill cache — assignee: karim_sre (in progress)
- Action: reissue intermediate with new notAfter and push via rotator — assignee: infra on-call (ben_dev)
- Action: notify customers + update status page — assignee: emily_support (done)
- Action: post-incident follow-up + RCA — assignee: alice_product

karim_sre: OCSP responder back to healthy, cache warming in progress. verifying across edges. sampling client requests show handshake success increasing.

infra-bot: metrics: 5xx rate dropped from peak 18% -> 1.8% over 12m after steer + intermediate apply. latency trending down.

sasha_oncall: marking mitigation success. keeping incident open for follow-up and cert reissue. handing off to karim for OCSP/checks and ben for reissue. I'm going offline in 20m — leaving note in incident tracker.

karim_sre: taking post-mitigation actions. I will: validate rotator audit logs, confirm reissued intermediate deployed, run end-to-end tests across regions, and prepare brief status for postmortem.

alice_product: thanks all. schedule 1hr postmortem in 48h, include OCSP team and rotator owners. severity: Sev2 -> resolved for customer impact; follow-up required.

incident-bot: incident thread closed for active mitigation. please update incident doc: https://incidents.internal/2695004321 

sasha_oncall: closing handoff. :white_check_mark:
